title: A high-adaptability ambient energy harvester enhanced by the canyon effect for smart agriculture
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EE02135B, Paper
Weilin Liao, Xiaosen Su, Huikang Li, Zijian Huang, Bingcheng Li, Jinsong Cai, Fei Fang, Ke Zhang, Xudong Huang, Zhong Lin Wang
This work presents a non-intrusive, modular harvester that synergistically integrates wind, solar, and raindrop energy harvesting with sensing capabilities for smart agriculture, underpinned by a canyon-effect-enhanced bi‑concave flow amplifier.
